input.subject: MV NORDIC HAWK / 28,500 MT UREA IN BULK / DAMIETTA-PARANAGUA - RECAP
input.body:
Gents,

Pleased to recap below clean fixed today, subs lifted:

MV NORDIC HAWK
Supramax, 58,200 DWT, Panama flag, blt 2014, geared 4x30T cranes/grabs

OWNERS: Nordic Bulk Carriers A/S, Hellerup
ACCT: Yara International ASA

- CARGO: abt 28,500 MT urea in bulk, 10 pct moloo chopt
- LOAD: 1 sb Damietta, Egypt
- DISCH: 1 sb Paranagua, Brazil
- LAYCAN: 04/10 June 2026
- FRT: USD 41.50 pmt FIOST 1/1
- LOADRATE: 12,000 mt pwwd shinc
- DISCH: 8,000 mt pwwd shinc
- DEM/DES: USD 18,500 / 9,250 pdpr fd bends
- ADDCOMM 2.5 pct plus 1.25 pct bro
- ARB London, English law, LMAA terms
- Owners to confirm last 3 cargoes prior to ld
- Demurrage payable within 30 days of receipt of owners inv together with supporting docs, time sheets duly signed by master and abt 25,000 MT whe
